label: Hard turn-off
tasteDescription: I love literary fiction — character studies, beautiful prose, morally complicated people. I will not read fantasy under any circumstances: no magic systems, no invented worlds.

label: Texture-match, not genre-match
tasteDescription: I'm looking for something with a really granular, immersive sense of place — I want to feel like I'm actually there — and characters who are morally ambiguous, not clearly good or bad. Genre doesn't matter much to me as long as it has that texture.
